$comment: Machine-readable conformance manifest (ES-02-002, ES-65-001). Maps repository units to canonical layers/components, owners, and controls.

units.description: Canonical envelope, header, error catalog, truth-state model, JCS canonicalization, audit hash structure — language-neutral source of truth
Volume 9 Appendix A design-token registry → CSS variables + Tailwind semantic aliases
Principals (human/workload), credentials, sessions, federation port, break-glass
Tenants, Customer Intelligence Domains, scope resolution, governed lifecycle
PDP + policy bundles + POL records; PEP guard lives in shared; internal append port
Hash-chained append-only audit ledger, chain heads allocator, seals, verifier, security intake; internal append port
Canonical object service, schema registry, transactional outbox, commit pipeline
Health/readiness — classified telemetry-only (documented, not a bypass)
WS-19 Platform and Customer Administration shell (access mode, never a truth store)

note_on_component_ids: CP-* namespace is a Volume-4-level extension (ADR-P0-03); Volume 3 Appendix A allocates IDs only for L1-L10 layers.

pinned_images.$comment: Remediation R7/R8 — local Compose infrastructure pinned by immutable digest; CI and the verification harness scan EXACTLY these digests (blocking at HIGH/CRITICAL, .trivyignore carries the dated CVE-level dispositions).

sbom_generator.$comment: Remediation R8 — validated SBOM generator, pinned and tracked; CI fails when the produced SBOM has zero components.

runtime_authorities.$comment: Gate-2.1 — one database credential per authority, and NO runtime role holds direct DML on any governed table: every write goes through a narrowly typed definer port whose bound capability is checked inside the boundary. The mintable action set is bound to the minting role. The break-glass recovery role is deliberately absent from every application pool.
runtime_authorities.eye_app: RLS-governed SELECT only; mints NO capability of any kind; caller-bound identity lookups only
runtime_authorities.eye_commit: governed business writes through bound ports (non-identity actions only): POL/AUD, canonical admission, outbox enqueue
runtime_authorities.eye_identity: identity/credential/session mutation, identity-flow and intake evidence, and the request evidence for identity.* actions only
runtime_authorities.eye_publisher: outbox lease + lease-tied compare-and-set acknowledgement only (no table UPDATE)
runtime_authorities.eye_verifier: audit verification, sealing and integrity evidence; cannot append audit events
runtime_authorities.eye_recovery: break-glass chain-head rebuild — no application pool loads this credential

migration_range: 0001-0012 (0011 and 0012 are governed forward migrations; 0001-0010 unchanged, digests still valid)

gate_scripts.$comment: Gate-2.1 §9 — the executable gate controls, tracked in-repo and re-runnable by a reviewer.
gate_scripts.database_paths: scripts/verify-db-paths.sh (forward upgrade + virgin install, each with the full suites)
gate_scripts.supply_chain_library: scripts/lib/supply-chain.mjs (licence gate, bidirectional reconciliation, CycloneDX 1.6 validation — shared by the CI scripts and the negative-fixture tests)
gate_scripts.evidence: scripts/generate-evidence.mjs (per-file manifest, archive digest, bundle, README with runnable reproduce commands)

supply_chain_gates.$comment: Gate-2.1 §9 — each gate has controlled negative fixtures in apps/api/test/gate/supply-chain.test.ts.
supply_chain_gates.cyclonedx_schema_validation: ajv (pinned workspace version) against the CycloneDX 1.6 structural schema, offline
supply_chain_gates.reconciliation: bidirectional (SBOM ↔ dependency closure) with governed exclusions in supply-chain-exclusions.json; stale exclusions fail the gate

sbom.$comment: Gate-2.1 — validated SBOM generator, pinned and tracked; CI fails when the SBOM is empty, fails CycloneDX 1.6 schema validation, or does not reconcile in BOTH directions with the dependency closure.
